description: Proves domain ownership to a SaaS product with a single constrained TXT record at a fixed host. The value is always prefixed dodomain-verify=; only the verification value is variable. Variant of dodomain.io/domain-verification, identical except that its variable is named verification instead of token, for DNS providers that reserve the token parameter name.
variableDescription: verification = the opaque verification token minted by DoDomain for this connect session.
